tokens.name: hl-navy
tokens.usage: Core. The dark ground: page background, hero, header and footer. Text on navy uses the hl-text-* steps.

tokens.name: hl-cream
tokens.usage: Core. The light ground (record bands, content slides) and headline ink on navy.

tokens.name: hl-gold
tokens.usage: Core. A line colour: 2px rules, link underlines, ghost button outline, focus ring, and the single primary button fill (navy label, 8.6:1). Never text on cream or white (1.9:1); never a background field.

tokens.name: hl-slate
tokens.usage: Core. Graphic elements only: engine rings, unlit arcs. Not for text (3.4:1 on navy).

tokens.name: hl-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Navy surface one step up from hl-navy, for a raised panel. Text steps hold their contrast here (faint 5.7:1).

tokens.name: hl-surface-core
tokens.usage: Navy surface for the engine graphic's core field.

tokens.name: hl-ring-unlit
tokens.usage: Unlit rings and arcs in the engine graphic. Decorative only.

tokens.name: hl-rule
tokens.usage: 1px hairline for structure on navy (section borders, card tops). Decorative structure, not a meaning-carrying border.

tokens.name: hl-text-on-navy
tokens.usage: Headlines and primary text on hl-navy and hl-surface-raised (16.3:1).

tokens.name: hl-text-body
tokens.usage: Paragraph copy on hl-navy and hl-surface-raised (10.9:1).

tokens.name: hl-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on hl-navy (8.9:1).

tokens.name: hl-text-faint
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, captions and footer text on hl-navy (6.2:1).

tokens.name: hl-text-on-cream
tokens.usage: Headlines, figures and primary text on hl-cream (16.3:1).

tokens.name: hl-text-faint-on-cream
tokens.usage: Eyebrows on hl-cream. Source value kept: 4.36:1 on hl-cream, just under 4.5:1 for small text (4.8:1 on white). Use at 13px+ medium weight only, never for long copy.

tokens.name: hl-rule-on-cream
tokens.usage: 1px hairline for structure on hl-cream. Decorative structure only.

tokens.name: hl-gold-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed fill (navy label 6.8:1). Also the source's link hover on cream, which reads only 2.4:1: rely on the gold underline, not the colour shift.

tokens.name: hl-link-hover
tokens.usage: Link text on hover, on navy grounds (12.4:1).

tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Semantic page ground. Navy theme: hl-navy (the default); Cream theme: hl-cream, for record bands and content slides.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Semantic raised surface. Cream has no raised step: it stays flat.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Semantic primary text on color-bg and color-surface in each theme.

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Semantic paragraph copy on color-bg in each theme.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Semantic accent: rules, primary fill, focus ring.

tokens.name: color-divider
tokens.usage: Semantic 1px hairline on color-bg in each theme.

tokens.name: color-bg-alt
tokens.usage: The other ground: the band that breaks the page (cream on a navy page).

styles.name: display
styles.sample: From rules to action. In weeks, not months.
styles.usage: Hero headline. Fluid via text-display (44 to 88px). Set font-stretch: var(--headline-stretch) (104%). Max about 14 words.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page and section headline. Fluid via text-h1 (34 to 52px), width 104%.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headline. Fluid via text-h2 (26 to 34px), width 104%. Long gold rule beneath.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Item title in lists and cards, width 102% (lead-stretch).

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: One proof figure in a record band, lining figures (lnum), width 104%. Approved numbers only.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: The system tells you what arrived. It cannot tell you what it means.
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a headline, max width measure-lead (34em).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A person signs off every finding. The record stands up.
styles.usage: All paragraph copy, max width measure-body (62ch).

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Each customer runs in its own segregated environment, hosted in Australia.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and footer text, sentence case, in hl-text-faint. Never all caps.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Specimen captions and legal lines only.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Stack under a headline; card vertical padding; footer padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section internal gap; list item gap.

radius.note: Corner radius is 0 everywhere. The only rounded shape is the favicon or app badge.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Every button, card, band and field.

rule.note: Rules carry structure; there are no drop shadows.

tokens.name: rule-hair
tokens.usage: Hairline thickness (hl-rule on navy, hl-rule-on-cream on cream).

tokens.name: rule-short
tokens.usage: Short gold rule above list items.

typescale.note: Fluid sizes and Archivo widths used by the stylesheet.

tokens.name: headline-stretch
tokens.usage: font-stretch for display, h1, h2, figures.

tokens.name: lead-stretch
tokens.usage: font-stretch for h3 and card titles.
